title: ACTman: Actigraphy Manager
text: Computed nparcalc() (via circadian_metrics()), following non-parametric method Van Someren et al. (1999) Witting et al. (1990), widely used circadian rhythm rest-activity research (including dementia, depression, shift-work studies): (Interdaily Stability) – similar 24-hour activity pattern day day. Computed ratio variance average 24-hour profile overall variance across hours. Ranges 0 (consistent daily pattern) towards 1 (highly repeatable pattern day day). IV (Interdaily Variability) – fragmentation rhythm: much activity changes one hour next, relative overall variance. Higher values indicate fragmented, less consolidated rhythm (transitions rest activity within day). L5 – average activity level 5 (clock-)hour span lowest activity average 24-hour profile (typically overnight sleep), along L5_starttime. M10 – average activity level 10 (clock-)hour span highest activity (typically main wake period), along M10_starttime. RA (Relative Amplitude) – (M10 - L5) / (M10 + L5), normalized measure day/night activity contrast (0 = contrast, 1 = maximal).

title: ACTman: Actigraphy Manager
text: Per-epoch wake/sleep classification (score_epochs(), used internally sleepdata_overview()) neighbor-weighted activity score: epoch’s score combines activity count weighted contribution 2 preceding 2 following epochs, thresholded classify epoch “awake” (score > 20) “asleep.” Per Kunkels et al. (2020) – paper describing ACTman – specific weighting scheme based CamNtech’s MotionWare “Information Bulletin . 3” documentation MotionWatch 8 device; ’s general family approach independently-developed Cole-Kripke algorithm (Cole et al., 1992). Sleep onset (“sleep start”) sleep offset (“sleep end”) within Bedtime--Gotup window located using rolling sums binarized activity threshold (sleep.chance / wakeup.chance), looking first sustained quiet period bedtime first sustained active period scheduled wake time. , sleepdata_overview() computes, per night: timeinbed, assumed_sleep, actual_sleep_duration, actual_sleep_perc actual_wake_duration, actual_wake_perc sleep.efficiency (actual sleep / time bed, %) sleep.latency (time Bedtime actual sleep onset)

title: ACTman: Actigraphy Manager
text: package organized small, mostly-single-responsibility modules. ACTman() orchestrator; everything else focused piece calls: Every read write goes actman_paths object (absolute, pre-normalized set paths workdir, managed_dir, results_dir, actogram_dir); function package calls setwd(). circadian EWS metric functions (circadian_metrics(), ews_metrics(), score_epochs()) pure: given input data frame, always return output, file /O, printing, setwd() side effects. makes independently unit-testable (see Testing) safe reuse outside full ACTman() pipeline. ACTman() still device-specific file reading preprocessing inline (period selection, 14-day length check, missing-data handling, managed-dataset writing) – extracting modules tracked modernization work.
code: R/   actman.R              # ACTman(): orchestrates the full pipeline per file   config.R               # actman_config(): validated configuration object   paths.R                # actman_paths(): absolute-path structure, no setwd() anywhere in the package   circadian_metrics.R    # IS/IV/RA/L5/M10 -- pure function, no I/O   ews_metrics.R          # Mean/Var/SD/CoV/Skewness/Kurtosis/Autocorr/Time-to-recovery -- pure function   nparcalc.R             # device-aware windowing, delegates to the two modules above   rolling_window.R       # run_rolling_window(): moving-window orchestration over nparcalc()   sleep_scoring.R        # score_epochs(): pure per-epoch wake/sleep classification   sleep_summary.R        # sleepdata_overview(): per-night sleep metrics, uses score_epochs()   sleeplog.R             # sleeplog_from_markers(): derive a sleeplog from event-marker files   actogram.R             # plot_actogram(), plot_EWS(), generate_actogram_plot()   increase_by_days.R     # DST-safe date arithmetic (via lubridate::days())   utils.R                # shared constants (MINUTES_PER_DAY, window sizes, etc.)

"continue" (default) proceeds; "abort" stops processing file. (Replaces old interactive readline() prompt batch/CI runs never hang.) on_missing_markers: passed sleeplog_from_markers() – see . title: circadian_metrics — circadian_metrics
text: ## Background standard non-parametric measures rest-activity rhythms used chronobiology circadian rhythm research: - **(Interdaily Stability)**: quantifies similar 24-hour   activity pattern day day. Ranges 0 (stable pattern)   towards 1 (highly stable/repeated pattern). Computed ratio   variance average 24-hour pattern overall variance. - **IV (Interdaily Variability)**: quantifies fragmentation   rhythm, .e. much activity changes one hour next   relative day--day variance. Higher values indicate   fragmented rhythm. - **L5**: average activity level 5 (clock-)hour period   lowest activity average 24-hour profile, L5_starttime   marking period begins. Represents "trough" rhythm   (typically nocturnal sleep). - **M10**: average activity level 10 (clock-)hour period   highest activity, M10_starttime marking begins.   Represents "peak" daytime activity period. - **RA (Relative Amplitude)**: (M10 - L5) / (M10 + L5),   normalized measure day/night activity contrast. Ranges 0   (contrast) 1 (maximal contrast).
